hard_nonclaims: The family known-cover denominator includes genus-assigned unmatched species but excludes unresolved genera, so it is conditional, not full unbiased completeness.
Exact GIFT name matching (34,888) and exact-name family resolution (potentially fewer) are separate source-gate measurements.
Height max traits in GIFT may reuse TRY/BIEN/AusTraits studies; independence and measurement units have not been audited.
Woodiness and growth form are categorical, not the quantitative height FD outcome.
The BIEN maximum whole plant height row is not assumed measurement-identical to GIFT plant_height_max.
Matching family labels does not yield any phylogenetic tips, patristic MPD, Rao Q, biomass or positive scientific association.
The frozen 90% exact binomial gate is NOT reset after the observed 87.7% match.

postrun_metadata_correction.reason: The original script mistakenly iterated over string work_ID keys, not sets of trait values, when counting ambiguous IDs; result field was incorrect.
postrun_metadata_correction.resolution: For all three GIFT traits, source_rows == unambiguous_values, so ambiguous IDs are 0. This correction does not modify species matches, plot eligibility, family lists, or biological outcomes.

scope: Source-only: counts, metadata and fixed-core overlaps; NO FD, MPD or biomass outcomes
